description: List the document's XML structure as a tree with element ids, tags, attributes, comments, processing instructions and what each element is tagged to (Structure pane). Ids are what the other XML tools take

from.description: An XML element: its id (from list_xml_structure), its path of child indexes from the root element ([] is the root), the first element an XPath expression matches, or selection: true for the element selected in the Structure pane (or the selected tagged item). Give exactly one

path.description: Child indexes from the root, e.g. [0, 2] is the third child of the root's first child

selection.description: Use the element selected in the Structure pane

xpath.description: XPath expression evaluated from the root element, e.g. //article[@id="a1"]

includeComments.description: Include XML comments and processing instructions

snippetLength.description: Characters of each element's text to include (0: none)

name: list_xml_structure
title: List XML Structure
